content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIO Project Associate I Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIO to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIO Project Associate - I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for NIO Project Associate - I Recruitment is 16 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate - I posts at NIO?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Associate - I posts in the National Institute of Oceanography (NIO) recruitment drive. Interested candidates should check the notification for details.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NIO Project Associate - I jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode for the NIO Project Associate - I recruitment is Online. Candidates need to visit the official website and fill out the application form electronically.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Project Associate - I at NIO?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Associate - I position at NIO will receive a salary of Rs. 25000 Per Month. This is a contractual position with a fixed monthly emolument.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Project Associate - I must have an M.Sc / M.Sc (Tech) / M.Tech in Geophysics / Marine Geophysics / Exploration Geophysics / Applied Geophysics from a recognized university or institution.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NIO Project Associate - I Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NIO Project Associate - I Recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Project Associate - I posts be located?
faq.answer: The Project Associate - I posts under NIO recruitment will be located in Goa, specifically in the city of Goa. Candidates should be prepared to work in this location.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website for NIO recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for National Institute of Oceanography (NIO) recruitment and other related information is https://www.nio.res.in. All official notifications and application links will be available there.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for Project Associate - I positions?
faq.answer: The Project Associate - I positions at NIO are of a Contractual job type. This means the employment will be for a specific period as outlined in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there an age limit for the Project Associate - I posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for the Project Associate - I posts. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any age relaxation rules.
